text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Once again, welcome. 
To our circus.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've prepared something truly 
special. 
The "Fuji Kiseki" you admire—the one 
you've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For instance, a side of me I rarely show. 
......Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dressed up like this, too. After showing 
you all of that... 
I want to show you what lies beyond. A new 
side of me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, keep your eyes glued to the stage. 
—Let the magic show begin.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Let us organize the issues then. 
"Staffing" and "Safety"... 
—Should our first priority be "Staffing"?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Staff, huh... Thanks to the mini circus, 
Flash and the others 
have joined us, but—hmm. Isn't this a bit 
inefficient?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey☆ How about we do a stream or a 
campus broadcast 
and call out, "Heeey! Let's do a circus★"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A broadcast... Yes, not a bad idea. 
However, will people really come just from 
an announcement?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. In that case, why not leave it to 
me? 
I've always wanted to try it once—a magic 
show on a livestream!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, I'll block the camera for just a 
split second... 
—No, if I do that, some people might see 
through the trick.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's check. 
Could you stop the recording?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Aha. How interesting, so that's how it 
looks on camera. 
A livestream really comes with a whole 
different set of things to consider.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How is it, how is it? Lookin' good? 
The real thing's tomorrow, though!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looks like the success rate is still 
pretty low. 
After all, it's not the kind of magic I'm 
used to doing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... fufu. No problem at all. 
With one full day left, that's more than 
enough time.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Got it! 
If Fuji says so, it'll totally be fine★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. Feel free to get your 
hopes up. 
—Living up to expectations is what I do, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To all the ponies gathered here and 
everyone watching, 
hello. —It's your Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A magic stream?" "What kind of trick is 
she doing!?" ...Fufu, don't rush me, 
alright? 
I promise I'll deliver something worthy of 
your time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell where I am right now? That's 
right, Tracen Academy. 
However! With a single snap of my 
fingers—3, 2, 1!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Aha. Mmm, what lovely weather! 
Look, a cow! The air out here is so 
refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No way..." "That's gotta be pre-recorded, 
right?" —Yeah, yeah. 
I totally get why you'd think that. But 
are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... why did she just read my 
comment!!?" "Whoa (shocked)" 
"Right, she couldn't read comments if it 
was pre-recorded!" "No freakin' way..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Is the background fake?" ...Ahaha, what a 
funny thing to say! 
Come on, take a look! Does this cow look 
fake to you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about I feed this cow right 
now? 
Hang tight. I'll go buy some food.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Huh. Did the video just glitch for a 
second...?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm back! ...Wait, where on earth am I? 
And after I went through the trouble of 
getting cow food, too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're in an entirely different 
place again~~~!? 
How does this trick even work~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the performance has come to 
an end. 
Fufu, did you enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I was so moved," "Amazing," "I want to 
see more"... Thank you! But 
if I managed to move your heart—I have a 
favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please, join me. 
Help me move the hearts of even more 
people.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight☆ The sign-up line for joining 
the troupe is over here! 
Line up, line up~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fuji-senpai! I watched your stream! 
Watching that made me want to lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too...! It's not really... returning 
the favor for what you've given us, but... 
It looked so fun... so, yes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, my little ponies. 
Your feelings make me so happy. —I look 
forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I watched it as well... and, well, it was 
thrilling. 
It was brimming with ambitious 
"playfulness," and I was utterly 
captivated.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yay! 
Though if it looked like I was challenging 
myself, that makes me even happier.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because that was the theme of this 
livestream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a great opportunity, I want to 
start showing it. 
A version of me taking on a higher 
challenge—a "me" that exceeds everyone's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Going beyond just "Fuji-san could probably 
pull this off"— 
Pulling *that* off is what makes me Fuji 
Kiseki, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, keep your eyes on me. 
Tomorrow will be even better than today, 
and the day after tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be an even more mesmerizing version 
of myself for you to fall in love with.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey☆ Is that the reason why you're 
doing the circus too, Fuji? 
A new challenge! You wanna take one on?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! That's right. 
I thought the circus stage would be the 
perfect place to test myself."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Marveloooous☆★☆ Sounds great, sounds 
great!★ 
Fuji's all fired up too!! With this, 
success is guaranteed!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, you're getting ahead of 
yourself... But yeah. 
Let's make sure it's a success, no matter 
what."
